findings.element: Platform chip panel (#recFilterBar → Platform → checkbox list), second checkbox click
findings.finding: The Platform panel is destroyed on the second checkbox toggle, so a second platform can never be selected and the panel's Apply button cannot be pressed.
findings.user_impact: The user cannot narrow the list to more than one platform — the exact primary task — and their second selection disappears with no message saying it was discarded.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the panel's layer registration alive across checkbox re-renders (register the new layer before tearing down the old one, and re-query the panel/trigger nodes after the refresh) so every toggle leaves the panel and its Apply button live.

evidence.action: Add filter → Platform, toggled Stripe (panel stayed open, Apply hit), then reopened the chip and toggled Shopify; liveness asserted with isVisible() plus an elementFromPoint hit test at the panel/Apply centre.
evidence.observed: After the second toggle: panel visible false, Apply hittable false, the selection was never committed, and the Platform chip showed 0 remove controls.

findings.element: Baseline date chip "Last 90 days (default)" → preset panel (All time / Last 7 / 30 / 90 days / This month / Last month) and its Apply button
findings.finding: Picking a preset closes the panel before its Apply can be pressed, and the pick is then discarded — the trigger still reads "Last 90 days" afterwards.
findings.user_impact: The user believes they changed the date range, gets no error or confirmation, and the date range in fact can never be changed at all — a silent dead end on a dimension the bar advertises as adjustable.
findings.suggested_fix: Either commit the pick on click and drop the Apply button from single-select panels, or keep the panel open after a pick so the Apply it displays is actually reachable — one rule, not both.

evidence.action: Opened the baseline date chip (Apply confirmed hittable on open), clicked "Last 30 days", then interacted a second time.
evidence.observed: Panel visible false, Apply hittable false, and the trigger still reads "Last 90 days" — the selection never reached the control the panel presents as the commit action.

findings.element: Platform chip on #recFilterBar after the panel is lost, plus the "Add filter" menu
findings.finding: Once a filter chip is on the bar in an uncommitted state there is no recovery affordance: the chip renders no × (0 remove controls counted) and "Add filter" no longer offers Platform.
findings.user_impact: A user who added the wrong filter, or hit UX-1, is stranded with a chip they can neither complete nor remove and has to reload the page or clear everything to get back.
findings.suggested_fix: Render the chip's × whenever the chip is on the bar rather than only while its value is active, so removing an added-but-unapplied filter is always one click.

evidence.action: After the Platform panel vanished on the second toggle, counted remove controls on the Platform chip and reopened "Add filter" to look for a re-entry point.
evidence.observed: Remove controls on the Platform chip: 0. Add filter re-offers Platform: false. No other control on the bar removes or reopens the chip.

findings.element: #recFilterBar as a whole — status segments vs "Add filter" menu vs filter panels
findings.finding: The same "pick a value" gesture means three different things on one bar: segments commit on click, the Add filter menu commits on pick with no Apply, and panels show an Apply that is unreachable (date) or reachable only for a first change (Platform).
findings.user_impact: Users cannot tell when a choice is already live and when it still needs Apply, so they either press Apply on things that already committed or walk away from panels believing a discarded selection took effect.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the panel rule uniform and visible — every panel stages until its Apply, no panel closes on a value change — so "click = live" applies only to the segments and nothing else.

evidence.action: Exercised all three commit paths in sequence: clicked "Add filter" → Platform, then the date panel presets, then the Platform panel checkboxes and Apply.
evidence.observed: Add filter had no Apply and inserted the chip on pick; the date panel displayed an Apply that closed before it could be used; the Platform panel's Apply worked once and then disappeared.

gaps: Platform panel: the first Apply was pressed but nothing was recorded about the 26-row list, the count line, or the chip label afterwards — whether a committed platform filter is actually reflected on screen is unknown.

Platform panel: the "Clear" button next to Apply was never pressed, so whether Clear removes the filter, whether it needs Apply after it, and whether it destroys the panel the way a second toggle does are all unknown.

recSegments (status) was never clicked, so what a commit-on-click segment does to an already-open filter panel holding staged edits is unrecorded — that is the one cross-control interaction on this bar.

"Simulate dashboard deep-link" and the resulting "From dashboard: …" status chip were never exercised, so whether a second status surface can visibly contradict the segments (the KF-7 failure class this variant claims to fix) is unverified.

The empty state ("No transactions match the current filters." + "Clear all filters") exists in markup but was never reached at runtime, so its recovery path — including whether it also drops added chips — is unverified.
Date chip: after the discarded pick, the row count and count line were not recorded, so it is unconfirmed whether the list stayed on the committed 90-day window or moved while the trigger lied.
